opening.text: I've been gaining weight over the last three months, and I frequently feel chilly. My hair is falling out more than usual, and my skin has become dry. I have been diagnosed with bipolar disorder and take lithium, which I started six months ago. Also, my periods used to be on a 4-week cycle, but recently they've extended to 6 weeks or longer.
